label: Bronchovascular texture pattern on quantitative CT reveals airway and vascular remodeling in post-COVID-19 Lungs.
summary: The long-term consequences of COVID-19 remain poorly understood. To assess CT image-based biomarkers and clinical symptoms in COVID-19 survivors approximately 3-4 years after infection. Eighty post-COVID-19 participants (81% infected with the pre-Alpha strain) underwent pulmonary function tests (PFTs) and inspiratory/expiratory CT at approximately 5 months (Visit 1, V1) and 3-4 years (Visit 2, V2) after infection.
